title: Carry on tracking after a break
description: Record a new purchase quickly while keeping the earlier history. Missed days are marked, and incomplete records are not passed off as an exact balance.

blocks.text: If several purchases go unrecorded, the numbers drift away from reality fast. In one review a person finds it hard to remember to enter expenses. The job of returning is to carry the current tracking on without pretending that the past period is complete.

quote.text: I’m 17, want to be better with money than my parents, and I’m using this, I got adhd and it colorful and customizable, I like it, only reason I got a problem is there’s no notifications, I got a hard time remembering to add things I bought so it gets out of wack fast if you’re not on top of it

blocks.text: Offer to reconcile the current balance and mark the period as incomplete. Keep the old transactions, let them be filled in later, and explain the adjustment to the amount explicitly. A reminder or a widget can make further entry easier, if the person chooses that themselves.

Ask the person to come back after a real break. Can they start from today and understand which reports are still incomplete? Convenience is judged on that scenario; it does not mean any proven change in impulsivity or behavior.
